A letter for you

My dear,

I'm sorry for the times I hurt you, and for the times I didn't listen. You deserved patience and I gave you less than that. I think about it every day.

Looking at these pictures reminds me how much laughter we shared, and how lucky I was to have you beside me. Those moments are some of the happiest I've ever had.

I'm not asking you to forget what happened. I'm asking for a chance to show you, with my actions, that I've learned and that I'll do better.

Always yours

Can we try again?

Whatever your answer is, thank you for reading this far.
